title: Choose the look for the Pilot-2 map
question: The roll picked the Operations Manual. Keep it, take the alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Operations Manual
options.lineage: a bank's tabbed procedure binder with swimlane process charts
options.thesis: The simulation explained the way a bank explains itself: one tab per department, one process chart per flow.
options.viewport: A clean five-tab overview chart (Outside, Harness, People, Engine, Scoring); each tab opens its own section with parts, tools and files; flows play as swimlane charts.
options.risk: Can feel like paperwork if the tabs are timid; the overview chart has to carry the page.

raised.raise: Arrow strokes carry meaning, not colour: solid = tool call, dashed = timer or wake, double = data written to the log.
Proposal vs built is a mark on each part (dashed outline = not built yet), never a hue.
Every flow shows a visible step spine, so you always see how many steps remain.

options.label: Design Document
options.lineage: engineering design docs and technical reference manuals
options.thesis: A system design doc: contents in a sidebar, Figure 1 up top, one numbered section per layer.
options.viewport: Left contents rail, title and one-paragraph summary, Figure 1 overview diagram, then sections per layer.
options.risk: The familiar choice: very readable, but it looks like every other design doc.

options.label: Developer Console
options.thesis: Architecture as persistent graphite panels with hairline seams.
options.viewport: Tiled panels: map, details, flow log.
options.risk: Dark-first; you flagged dark-mode colours as a problem.
options.case: Loses on both axes for a reader learning the plan.
options.kept: Panels persist: opening a part changes the panel, not the whole layout.

options.label: Normalled Jackfield
options.thesis: Every link drawn as a line whose stroke pattern is its state.
options.viewport: Numbered lanes of parts tied by amber lines.
options.risk: Amber on black is hard to read for long.
options.case: A costume for a reading page.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Flows as frames strung along a perforated rail.
options.viewport: A rail of frames, one per flow step.
options.risk: Orange on black, one type size: unreadable for dense details.
options.kept: State as a mark, not a colour.

options.label: Exposed Binding
options.thesis: Structure showing: the spine counts the sections.
options.viewport: A flat-open book with a stitched spine.
options.risk: Warm craft look fights a system diagram.
options.kept: A visible spine that shows how many steps remain.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Blocks of weather cut and stacked.

options.label: Industrial Plate
options.thesis: Forms flattened into hard planes under one light.
options.viewport: One big stencilled numeral and planes.
options.kept: One light source: the active part is lit, the rest recede.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A standard architecture diagram page, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: One diagram with a details side panel.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other diagram page.
